certifications.name: SOX Section 404
certifications.description: Internal controls over financial reporting. Revenue-accounting systems are in scope because they feed the general ledger.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.description: Operational controls attestation covering security, availability and confidentiality. 12-month audit window ends at the hard deadline. Failure risks customer-contract renewals.

certifications.name: Data Privacy Regulation
certifications.description: Personal data exposure during a prior incident triggered a regulator review. Encryption at rest, access logs and retention policies must be certified before the hard deadline.

phases.name: Discovery
milestones: Code access granted for all apps in scope

phases.name: Execution
milestones: Credentials centralization complete across all apps
SQL injection fixes landed in production for apps 01, 02, 04
Anti-corruption layer designed for legacy databases

phases.name: Testing and UAT
milestones: Automated test coverage >= 70% on critical paths
Security scan clean-up (0 BLOCKER / 0 CRITICAL remaining)

phases.name: Production cutover and compliance sign-off
milestones: Production cutover for all apps on schedule
SOX + SOC 2 + privacy certifications signed off
Post-launch monitoring and incident runbooks in place

audit_cadence: Monthly steering committee, day 14 of each month
narrative: Publicly-traded enterprise with a 4.5-month modernization window from the start of execution to the hard production-readiness deadline. Three certifications in scope: a financial-controls framework, a security operations attestation and a data-privacy regulation. Each tracks against the same hard deadline to unify steering reporting.
